work.estimate_formula: ceil(source_size_bytes * temp_multiplier) + fixed_bytes; multiplied by scheduled iterations only when artifacts are retained

checkpoint_estimate_policy.note: one successful canonical tensors/blocks report per configuration; matching technical repetitions retain top-level reports and local references

configuration.cache_policy: best-effort buffered I/O; integrity hashing and prior runs can warm pages; the harness neither drops host caches nor guarantees page residency
configuration.io_policy: Brevis reads the immutable source directly and writes regular on-disk archive/restored files; hashing and full verification occur after each timed process
configuration.timing_scope: external wall/RSS: immediately before process spawn through direct-child reap; internal bench/calibration fields retain their CLI-defined narrower scopes
configuration.scheduling_policy: serial execution; all archive pipelines precede all diagnostic replays; within each stage, warmups rotate and deterministic randomized measured orders are paired with their reverse
